title: Mensa pin and tie pins
summary: Allen and Rose chat about tie pins and Rose's Mensa membership, which he found disappointing.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: And nobody wears them. They wear pins stuck through their ties sometimes. You see that? That's sort of a kind of thing. And of course, the old New Orleans tradition is the diamond stick pin. Whether you have a tie on or not. Well, you still wear a pin yourself, right here in your lapel.
Oh, yeah. That's my Mensa pin. And I don't know. I think I just wear that anymore to remind myself of which suit I had on last. I see.

Well, Mensa is an organization of people whose IQs are in the first 2% of the population. And it does not fulfill any of the aims that I hoped it would. And so I haven't been active in it virtually since the time I joined.
All over the United States. They have a chapter in New Orleans. I've never been to it, but there is one.
You mean there are people in New Orleans?
